articles.title: Cuba tells US to lift blockade instead of offering aid as energy crisis worsens
articles.description: The Communist-run island has seen rare protests over worsening power cuts due to shortages of fuel.

articles.title: Could Iran war trigger a hunger crisis?
articles.description: The UN warns disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz could drive up food and fertiliser costs, and worsen global hunger.

articles.title: SpaceX IPO prospectus could land as soon as next week, sources say
articles.description: Elon Musk's reusable rocket company is getting closer to what's expected to be a record stock market debut.

articles.title: This summer’s World Cup will be no match for Taylor Swift when it comes to live events
articles.description: The World Cup runs from June 11 to July 19, with games being played in cities across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Tickets went on sale in October and have sold for as much as $10,000, with the cheapest options to see the U.S. team running around $1,640.

articles.title: Jerome Powell: Steering the US Fed through COVID-19 and political pressures
articles.description: Trump’s aggressive push for interest rate cuts shaped Powell’s Fed legacy during his tumultuous leadership.

articles.title: War criminal Ratko Mladić's jail release request denied
articles.description: A UN judge admits the 84-year-old is "in the final stages of his life", but says prison conditions in The Hague ensure his maximum comfort.

articles.title: Giant new dinosaur identified from fossils in Thailand
articles.description: The nagatitan is the largest dinosaur found in South-East Asia and weighs as much as nine elephants.

articles.title: China will work behind the scenes to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz, Bessent says
articles.description: President Trump held talks with President Xi during a two-day summit in Beijing on Thursday.

articles.title: Musk's China trip during OpenAI trial prompts apology from his lawyer for CEO's absence
articles.description: Musk sued his OpenAI co-founders Sam Altman and Greg Brockman, alleging they had violated a promise to keep their company a nonprofit.

articles.title: Lamine Yamal divides opinion with Palestinian flag gesture
articles.description: A mural of Barcelona player Lamine Yamal was painted in Gaza after the teenager waved a Palestinian flag.

articles.title: Xi tells Musk, Tim Cook and other CEOs on Trump's trip: China will 'open wider'
articles.description: Tesla and Space X boss Elon Musk, Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang and Apple CEO Tim Cook were part of Trump's delegation.

articles.title: Court overturns Alex Murdaugh's murder convictions and orders new trial
articles.description: The court has ordered a new trial over the June 2021 killings of Paul and Maggie Murdaugh.
